body:
## Purpose

Previously, FlashInfer would choose to use decode CUDA graphs if `num_decodes < threshold`, even if spec decoding was enabled and the number of tokens in the batch was much higher. This can cause issues when `num_decode_tokens > max_cudagraph_size`.

I fixed the check to correctly use `num_decode_tokens` instead, and also updated the constructor to update the threshold to a higher value when speculative decoding is used.
title: [Bugfix] Fix CUDA graph selection bug in FlashInfer at high concurrency
